post.caption:
Roughly 10 million hectares of forest are lost every year, driven mainly by cattle pasture, soy, palm oil and logging. But the number moves: Brazil's rate has dropped sharply in some periods and tree cover is rising in parts of Asia. What moves it is policy and price, not moralising.
